purpose: FOUR-ROW SMOKE for SAEA-SLURP-DEV1000-CLOSED-LIST-DIRECT-V1. Same baseline fragment, same model fragment, same dataset fragment, same arm, same packets, same instruction -- four samples instead of one thousand. It exists to prove the runtime end to end (preflight, packet promotion, serve, dispatch, seal as a core.bundle run manifest, official scoring) BEFORE the registered flight, because this is the first SLURP cell ever flown through core.flight.FlightRuntime: every sealed SLURP arm before it went through rails.runner's speech-native agent loop and left no *.run-manifest.json behind. Its own exposure row, its own run id, its own attempt accounting; its numbers are a wiring proof and are never reported as a result.

populations.basis: The first four DEV-1000 sample ids in sorted order. Named HERE, in the registered fragment, rather than passed on a command line, so a smoke can never quietly fly four different rows than the ones its exposure row names (the SAEA-E22-ESB precedent).

budget_basis: 4 contacts plus margin for one permitted recovery within the same run id = 12 planned model calls. The four rows' own audio is 14.28 seconds; 60 is the rounded ceiling. GPU hours 0.3 covers a cold model load plus four contacts. Paid API spend 0. Plan cells are RUN-CUMULATIVE across every attempt of this run id.
